artifact_publish_note: Publishing is split across two sessions as of 2026-09-04: this local run writes candidate_registry.json to artifact_relay_file; the cloud routine at artifact_publish_routine_id (cron 0 16,0 * * * UTC = 9:00am/5:00pm Pacific, same clock as the local run per Max) reads that file and publishes to artifact_url. The local run never calls Artifact directly -- confirmed unavailable in this session type.
notes: notify_via is desktop_notification, not Slack -- see SKILL.md 'Why desktop notification, not Slack' for the reasoning (self-DM/self-mention on this Slack connector does not push a notification, and it keeps candidate PII out of chat transcripts).
